providers.name: ResetData
providers.owner: ResetData (Centuria Capital owns 50%, per press coverage)
providers.how_to_buy: Serverless pay-per-token API in AUD; dedicated GPUs by enquiry
providers.note: Only the serverless list is public; the full catalogue needs a login.

providers.name: Xinference
providers.owner: Xinference (says it is Australian; not checked)

providers.name: Continuum Labs
providers.owner: Continuum Labs Pty Ltd, Melbourne (says it is Australian owned)

providers.name: AWS Bedrock (Sydney, Melbourne)
providers.how_to_buy: Pay-per-token in AWS regions ap-southeast-2 and ap-southeast-4

not_checked.name: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry (Australia East)
not_checked.reason: Region availability isn't in a table we can read reliably yet.

not_checked.name: Google Vertex AI (australia-southeast1)
not_checked.reason: Region availability isn't in a table we can read reliably yet.

not_checked.name: Amaze
not_checked.reason: Lists 34 open models for Sydney and Melbourne, all marked coming soon (checked 2026-11-05).

not_checked.name: Groq
not_checked.reason: Runs a 4.5MW inference site at Equinix Sydney (Nov 2025), but publishes no way to keep requests in Sydney.

not_checked.name: Sharon AI
not_checked.reason: Australian GPU cloud with an inference engine; no public list of hosted models (checked 2026-11-05).

not_checked.name: Data Global
not_checked.reason: DGX B300 cluster at Micron21 for a 'Token Factory' inference platform, not launched yet.

not_checked.name: Micron21 (mCloud)
not_checked.reason: Sells GPUs to run your own models; no hosted model list.

not_checked.name: NorthStar
not_checked.reason: Says it serves Gemma 3 from South Australia; no official site or API domain we could confirm.

not_checked.name: Sovereign Australia AI
not_checked.reason: Builds Australian models; no public inference catalogue found.
